phase: Phase 1 - Canonical Mission Lifecycle and Run Control

mission_id.definition: Authoritative stable identifier for the entire logical mission lifecycle.
mission_id.format: m_[hex8] (e.g., m_3f8a12c4) or caller-provided stable id.
mission_id.lifespan: Spans all runs, attempts, pauses, resumes, and terminal states of the mission.

run_id.lifespan: Scoped strictly to a single execution run attempt. Fresh run_id generated on each restart or retry.

attempt_number.definition: Monotonically increasing integer tracking run attempts.
attempt_number.monotonicity_rule: attempt_{n+1} >= attempt_{n}. Re-entrant attempts with stale numbers are rejected.

StateReducer.enforcement: Rejects events with event.run_id != state.mission.run_id and event.mission_id != state.mission.mission_id
